Version 0.85.0

### ✨ New

- Added a system theme mode that follows the device's light or dark appearance.
- Added image input support for the DeepSeek Harness agent.

### 🐛 Fixes and Improvements

- Fixed an issue where pressing Esc while using an IME could cause focus to be lost.
- Improved drag-and-drop interactions for conversation mentions.
- Ensured that Grok permission settings are applied when starting and resuming sessions.
- Improved DeepSeek Harness startup compatibility and stability.
